{{Quote|I know the catalog number and some other characteristics of the asteroid we're on&mdash;or in, if you prefer. Its configuration is unique, and has been noticed in the past.|Vuffi Raa, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
A small '''asteroid''' was located in the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The floating metal-rich rock was situated in an irregular cluster of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and had a deep and narrow crevasse that stretched around its circumference, which was unique enough to merit the asteroid's inclusion in a catalog of the Oseon [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] bodies. When the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was traveling through the Oseon system during the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]] phenomenon, an attack by the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Zero Squadron|squadron]] of the [[Renatasian Confederation]] forced the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to hide the [[Light freighter/Legends|vessel]] in the unusual asteroid's crevasse.

While on the asteroid, the occupants of the ''Falcon'' made repairs to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], using to their benefit the fact that the celestial object was shielding them from the ionizing [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] of the Flamewind. During the vessel's stay on the asteroid, one of its passengers, [[Waywa Fybot]], also attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Calrissian by [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaging]] his [[Environment suit/Legends|vacuum suit]]. Ultimately, Calrissian used the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] to cause the asteroid to burst apart, damaging the Renatasian [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was still searching for the ship and allowing the vessel to resume its voyage through the Oseon system.

==Description==
===Astrographical data===
{{Quote|However, the catalog has some information: this asteroid is uninhabited, but it isn't uncharted.|Vuffi Raa|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:Oseon-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The asteroid was a part of the Oseon system.]]
An [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] was situated in the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]],<ref name="LCFO" /> a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Along with the rest of the Oseon [[Star system/Legends|system]], the asteroid was connected by the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Arleen system/Legends|Arleen system]], while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Cadma Conduit]] linked it to the [[Erilnar system/Legends|Erilnar system]] and the<ref name="TEA" /> [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Dagelin Minor system/Legends|Dagelin Minor]] and [[Simbarc system/Legends|Simbarc systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The asteroid was part of a small cluster of approximately a hundred worldlets that were following their own course through the narrow space between the [[Fifth Belt|Fifth]] and [[Sixth Belt]], two of the seven broad [[Oseon asteroid belt|bands]] of [[Planet/Legends|subplanetary]] bodies that [[Orbit/Legends|circled]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] system's [[Oseon sun|sun]]. The asteroids of the cluster were located very close to each other, and none were larger than a few [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter.<ref name="LCFO" />

===Physical traits===
{{Quote|How lucky it was that this crevice runs perpendicular to the direction of the Flamewind. Were it a few degrees the other way, it would function as a funnel or a wave guide and concentrate the&mdash;|Vuffi Raa|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
The [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]], uninhabited asteroid had negligible [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull and was mostly composed of metal-bearing rock. When the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by its [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], sought refuge on the asteroid, its substance partially shielded the [[Light freighter/Legends|starship's]] navigational and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment from the effects of the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]] phenomenon ongoing at the [[Time/Legends|time]], leading Calrissian to speculate that the asteroid was composed of [[Iron/Legends|iron]] and [[nickel]].<ref name="LCFO" />

The asteroid had a deep crevasse that had formed either as a result of an incomplete splitting of a single celestial body into two halves or due to a collision and a subsequent imperfect merger of two separate objects. The crevasse did not exceed twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in width and stretched around the asteroid's circumference at a length of seventy or eighty kilometers.<ref name="LCFO" />

==History==
===Encountering the asteroid===
{{Quote|What happened? Where are we?''"<br />"''Two very good questions. We were attacked&mdash;I don't know by whom&mdash;and we escaped. But I don't know to where.|Bassi Vobah and Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:VuffiNew.png|thumb|left|300px|Vuffi Raa, the Renatasian Confederation's pursuit of which led the ''Millennium Falcon'' to hide on the asteroid]]
The unusual shape of the asteroid led to it being registered at some point in a catalog listing the orbital bodies of the Oseon system, with the document noting the asteroid's catalog number as well as several of its other characteristics such as its orbital elements.<ref name="LCFO" /> At some point between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] novel trilogy, including ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> while the light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''Millennium Falcon'' was [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] [[Oseon Peacekeeper]] Captain [[Bassi Vobah]] and undercover [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] narcotics agent [[Waywa Fybot]] between the asteroids [[Oseon 6845]] and [[Oseon 5792]], the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] came under an attack by<ref name="LCFO" /> the [[Renatasian Confederation]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>&mdash;a [[Renatasian|group]] devoted to exacting vengeance upon [[Vuffi Raa]], the [[Class Two multi-phasic robot|droid]] copilot of the ''Falcon'', whom it wrongfully held responsible for the [[Battle of Renatasia|subjugation]] of the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="LCFO" />

During the ensuing skirmish between the ''Falcon'' and the Renatasian [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Zero Squadron|squadron]], the former starship's captain, Lando Calrissian, was forced to deviate from his vessel's [[Dead-reckoning program|pre-programmed]] course toward Oseon 5792 that had been mandated by the ship's navigational and sensor instruments being affected by the Oseon system's ongoing [[Local year|annual]] Flamewind phenomenon. Noticing the asteroid cluster that contained the double asteroid with the assistance of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} compromised sensor equipment, Calrissian piloted the ship straight through the formation until he first saw the unusual celestial body. The captain established a tangent course toward the double asteroid, correctly orienting the ''Falcon'' by standing the vessel on its nose and steering the ship toward the asteroid's prominent crevasse. At the last possible moment during the approach, Calrissian gently brought the ''Falcon'' to a stop deep within the crack, with the ship's upper and lower [[Hull/Legends|hull]] sections being wedged against the faces of the canyon.<ref name="LCFO" />

===Refuge===
{{Quote|In any case, we were attacked, by a collection of odd military spacecraft. We took refuge. Some repairs were required.|Waywa Fybot, on the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} occupants|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
[[File:MillenniumFalcon-FlamewindOfOseon.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' at the time of its visit of the asteroid]]
The Renatasian Confederation, which had pursued the ''Falcon'', did not notice the spot where the ship had hidden itself and began circling the double asteroid and searching the crevasse for its quarry. Meanwhile, Calrissian noticed that the asteroid's crevasse, which ran perpendicular to the direction of the Flamewind, was partially shielding the ''Falcon'' from the stream of [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] caused by the phenomenon. The captain subsequently invited Vuffi Raa, who had also been affected by the flux of ionizing particles, to quit his refuge in the [[Steel/Legends|steel]] safe of the ship's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] and helped the [[Silentium|droid]] to reattach his previously disconnected manipulator tentacles.<ref name="LCFO" />

Calrissian then checked on his passengers, Vobah and Fybot, in the ''Falcon''{{'s}} lounge, which had suffered the effects of the ship performing intense maneuvers with both its [[Artificial gravity/Legends|artificial gravity]] and [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial dampers]] turned off during the skirmish against the Renatasian starfighters. Calrissian and Vobah splinted Fybot's [[Limb/Legends|legs]], which had been broken during that event, after which the ship's crew attended to the damage the vessel had sustained during its voyage and the fight against the Renatasians. During a break from the work, Calrissian and Vobah had a [[Diet/Legends|meal]] from covered free-fall trays in the lounge while Vuffi Raa and Fybot were playing a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="LCFO" />

===Attempt on Calrissian's life===
{{Quote|Sir, believing&mdash;on account of our pursuers&mdash;that Calrissian had become a liability, I took the initiative in attempting to dispose of him by sabotaging his vacuum suit.|Waywa Fybot, to [[Rokur Gepta]], disguised as Bohhuah Mutdah|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
Later, Calrissian wore a [[Environment suit/Legends|vacuum suit]] and set about [[Riveting gun|riveting]] [[micropole]]s to the outside of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} top and bottom hull in order to increase the overlap and effective density of the ship's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]]. Assisted by Vuffi Raa, who was monitoring the process from inside the ship, Calrissian eventually became tired of the claustrophobic work in the narrow space between the ''Falcon''{{'s}} lower hull and the face of the asteroid's crevice, and he returned to the ship for a five-[[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] break. Around the same time, Vuffi Raa also speculated that an offset of merely a few degrees of the direction of the crevasse they were in from the perpendicular to the Flamewind would have led to the natural formation amplifying the detrimental effects of the phenomenon upon the ''Falcon'' and its occupants instead of diminishing them.<ref name="LCFO" />

[[File:Lando-FlamewindCover.jpg|thumb|left|300px|On the asteroid, an attempt was made on Lando Calrissian's life.]]
In order to visit the ship's [[Toilet/Legends|toilet]], Calrissian removed his [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] suit. Meanwhile, Fybot believed that Calrissian had become a liability to his and Vobah's mission to arrest the trillionaire [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]] on Oseon 5792 due to the ''Falcon''{{'s}} encounter with the Renatasian Confederation; the narcotics agent also felt that disposing of Calrissian would help disrupt Vobah's performance during the arrest attempt on Mutdah, for whom Fybot was secretly working. Correspondingly, the officer [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the captain's suit by [[Programmer/Legends|crossprogramming]] its [[Comlink/Legends|communicator]] with its [[Temperature/Legends|cooling]] system.<ref name="LCFO" />

After Calrissian set out to fasten the micropoles on the ''Falcon''{{'s}} upper hull, his suit began to undergo a [[Heat sink/Legends|heat-sink]] overload due to the sabotage. Realizing that he could not raise the ship on his communicator and that he would possibly not be able to return to the vessel's [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] in time due to the suit's malfunction, Calrissian instead established communication with Vuffi Raa by methodically rapping against the wheel&mdash;wedged against the asteroid's wall&mdash;of the nearby airlock with his riveting gun. Vobah, wearing a vacuum suit of her own, then went after Calrissian and brought the overheated captain back into the ship, whereupon Vuffi Raa determined that Calrissian's suit had been sabotaged.<ref name="LCFO" />

===Departing the asteroid===
{{Quote|Get out of there, old automaton, strap yourself in the jumpseat behind us, and warn me if anybody comes up the tunnel to the cockpit. I may be able to get us out of this mess, but I want my back safe and my elbows unjogged.|Lando Calrissian, to Vuffi Raa|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
The recuperated Calrissian then had another meal, after which he and Vuffi Raa made an unsuccessful attempt to discern from the ''Falcon''{{'s}} radiation-damaged [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] the double asteroid's exact location in the Oseon system. When the droid informed Calrissian of his similarly useless knowledge about the asteroid from the system's astronomical catalog, the captain decided they would simply follow the pre-programmed course to Oseon 5792 as if they had not deviated from it due to the skirmish against the Renatasians, and then attempt to correct for the error as they arrived closer to the target asteroid.<ref name="LCFO" />

[[File:StarcaveLando.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Lando Calrissian, the asteroid's destroyer]]
When Calrissian was later discussing with Vobah and Fybot his suspicions that one of them had attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, Vuffi Raa interrupted the conversation by summoning the captain to the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], as the Renatasian [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] had arrived in the vicinity of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} hiding place. The recollection of a conversation on [[Diamond/Legends|diamonds]] he had had earlier with Vuffi Raa then gave Calrissian an idea for a plan on how to evade the starfighters while leaving the refuge of the asteroid.<ref name="LCFO" />

As the Renatasian flybys of the crevasse became more frequent due to the squadron narrowing its search, Calrissian began gradually expanding the deflector shields of the ''Falcon'', the main strength of which was normally concentrated just under the first few molecules of the ship's skin, away from the vessel. The shields of the tightly wedged-in ship steadily pushed against the canyon walls until one of the probing Renatasian fighters finally discovered the ''Falcon''. At that moment, Calrissian suddenly increased the shields' distance from the ship to its maximum value, which caused the asteroid to explode due to the stresses exerted upon it. Hurtling rock fragments from the explosion damaged the Renatasian squadron, causing secondary explosions of at least eight starfighters and preventing the unit from attacking the ''Falcon'' as the ship subsequently resumed its voyage to Oseon 5792.<ref name="LCFO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The asteroid appeared in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', the [[1983]] second entry in [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels by [[L. Neil Smith]]. In the novel, the crevasse located on the asteroid is described as both "seventy or eighty kilometers long" and "hundreds of kilometers in extent." This article assumes the latter description is erroneous.<ref name="LCFO" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed the Oseon system, and therefore the asteroid, in the [[Zebitrope sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by establishing that the Oseon system was situated in grid square T-8 as part of the Centrality.<ref name="TEA" />
